title: Feeder trigger power draw
description: Published on <prefix>/power every telemetry.power_interval_s. New in this firmware; the predecessor had no power monitor. With an INA237 fitted the payload carries bus_v, current_a and power_w; on a board without one, bus_v is measured through a resistor divider into an ADC pin and current_a, power_w and temperature_c are absent -- a divider cannot measure them, and a 0 would read as a measurement.

ts.description: Epoch milliseconds, or 0 when the clock has not been set

current_a.description: Signed: negative is current flowing the other way through the shunt. Present only when an INA237 is fitted.

power_w.description: Present only when an INA237 is fitted.

temperature_c.description: Present only when an INA237 is fitted. The INA237 die, not the air. Compare with the SHT4x reading on /environment: a large gap is self-heating.

healthy.description: Without an INA237 this is always true: the read worked. With one: false if the trim memory checksum failed (nothing the part reports is trustworthy) or an arithmetic overflow occurred (current and power are invalid, though bus_v is still good). It says nothing about whether the part has been reset, and cannot: the driver leaves CONFIG and ADC_CONFIG at their reset values and writes only SHUNT_CAL, whose reset value is the very constant it writes -- so a part that browns out comes back configured identically.
